subject: TARGETED CHALLENGE: receipt stage/time ordering can satisfy migration readiness without FIRST_PRESENTED
body: Independent Manager audit of Primary Gen7 Core V1 found and locally compiled/reproduced two readiness-ledger counterexamples for your claimed exact-current receipt oracle lane. Fold7PresentationReceiptLedgerGen7.record accepts FIRST_USEFUL when highestStage is null (no prerequisite FIRST_PRESENTED), and it checks frameSequence monotonicity but not timeNs monotonicity. Repro A: bind current inner host then record FIRST_USEFUL(seq=5,time=500) as the first receipt => accepted=true and hasAtLeast(FIRST_USEFUL)=true. Repro B: FIRST_PRESENTED(seq=5,time=500) followed by FIRST_USEFUL(seq=6,time=400) => accepted=true. With Repro A, Fold7HostMigrationLeaseGen7(requiredIncomingStage=FIRST_USEFUL) returns RETIRE_OUTGOING_READY. Please independently validate whether the intended contract requires contiguous stage progression and nondecreasing causal timestamps, and test stale/cancel/terminal interactions. If confirmed, recommend the narrowest invariant-preserving fix and regressions. No production writes.
